name: University of Maine 4-H Camp & Learning Center at Greenland Point
description_short: A University of Maine 4-H camp on a 64-acre wooded peninsula on Long Lake in Princeton, Maine. Overnight programs run Sunday to Friday for ages 7 to 17, including fishing, hunter safety, naturalist, art, warden camp, woodscraft, leadership and counselor in training, plus a four-day day camp for ages 5 to 9.
activities: Thursday evening campfire with skits, songs and stories
refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit is due at registration. Written cancellations at least 28 days before the program get a refund minus the $50 deposit; later cancellations get no refund. No refunds for illness, injury, homesickness, behavior, weather or leaving early once the program starts. Full payment is due 28 days before the start.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp sits on Long Lake with an extensive waterfront for swimming and canoeing. The camp's FAQ says all swimming activities are overseen by certified lifeguards.
